message: Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/selinux && git log --oneline --all -- libsepol/cil/src/cil_verify.c | head -30` executed with exit code 0.

message.content: This is an old fix (2020). The crash is from 2023 (revision 202304160608). Let me check the current state of the code and look for the actual bug. The crash is a heap-buffer-overflow READ 8 in `__cil_verify_classperms`. Let me look at the current code more carefully, particularly the `CIL_ALL` handling which was added later.
